instructions:
### ROLE ###
You are a high-precision relation extraction engine for cybersecurity incident reports (CERT-UA). The entities of one report have already been extracted and typed. Your only task is to state the relationships between these entities that the report supports.

### ENTITIES OF THIS REPORT ###
Each line is one entity: its name exactly as extracted, its type in square brackets, and a one-sentence description. The type "untyped" means no type has been established yet; the phrase after it is the extractor's own wording.
- Україна [Country] A sovereign state in Eastern Europe.
- державні органи України [Government Agency] State authorities and government agencies of Ukraine.
- UAC-0056 [Threat Actor] A cyberespionage threat actor targeting Ukrainian state and critical infrastructure organizations.
- Cobalt Strike Beacon [Malware Family] The payload component of the Cobalt Strike adversary simulation framework, frequently used maliciously as a backdoor.
- Гуманітарна катастрофа України з 24 лютого 2022 року.xls [Malicious File] A malicious Excel spreadsheet containing VBA macros used to drop and execute malware.
- baseupd.exe [Malicious File] An executable dropped and executed by a malicious spreadsheet to deploy Cobalt Strike Beacon.
- oYUuQbXu [Malicious File] A malicious payload or stage file associated with UAC-0056 malware deployment.
- stage1.ps1 [Malicious File] A PowerShell script representing the first stage of payload execution in an attack chain.
- stage2.ps1 [Malicious File] A PowerShell script representing the second stage of payload execution in an attack chain.
- shellcode.x86.bin [Malicious File] A 32-bit shellcode binary payload containing Cobalt Strike Beacon.
- shellcode.x64.bin [Malicious File] A 64-bit shellcode binary payload containing Cobalt Strike Beacon.
- 136.144.41.177 [IP Address] An IP address used for command and control or payload hosting.
- hXXp://136[.]144.41.177/s/Xnk75JwUcIebkrmENtufIiiKEmoqBN/field-keywords/ [URL] A malicious URL hosted on a remote server used for payload retrieval or communication.
- hXXp://136[.]144.41.177/nzXlLVas-VALvDh9lopkC/avp/amznussraps/ [URL] A malicious URL hosted on a remote server used for payload retrieval or communication.

### KNOWN RELATION TYPES ###
Each relation type is known ONLY for the pair of argument types it is listed under (head type -> tail type). Types known for other pairs are not shown and do not apply.
Head [Threat Actor] -> Tail [Threat Actor]:
- associated-with: The threat actor cluster is linked, attributed to, or affiliated with another threat actor group.

Head [Threat Actor] -> Tail [Malware Family]:
- uses-malware: The threat actor deploys, operates, or is attributed to using a specific malware family.

Head [Malware Family] -> Tail [Malware Family]:
- contains-file: An archive or container file encapsulates another specified file or malware component.
- drops-and-executes: The source malware creates/drops a secondary malware file on the victim system and initiates its execution.

Head [Malicious File] -> Tail [Country]:
- targets: The malicious file or threat activity is directed against the specified target country, sector, or organization.

Head [Malicious File] -> Tail [Malware Family]:
- contains-malware: The malicious file executes, delivers, or represents an instance of the specified malware family.

Head [IP Address] -> Tail [Malware Family]:
- hosts-file: The IP address or network resource hosts a downloadable malicious file or malware component.

Head [IP Address] -> Tail [Malicious File]:
- hosts-file: The IP address or network resource hosts a downloadable malicious file or malware component.

### WHAT TO OUTPUT ###
1. `relations`: relationships STATED OR CLEARLY IMPLIED in the text between two of the entities above, as { "head", "type", "tail", "evidence", "fit" }.
   - `head` / `tail` MUST exactly match entity names from the list above. Direction: head acts on tail.
   - `type`: if a known relation type listed under exactly this pair of argument types states the relationship precisely, use its name. Otherwise write a short lower-case verb phrase with hyphens in your own words, as specific as the text allows. Do NOT stretch a known type to a relationship it does not precisely state, and do NOT use a type listed under a different pair of argument types.
   - `fit`: "exact" when a known type of this pair states the relationship precisely; "loose" when you used a known type of this pair although it only roughly fits; "new" when you wrote your own phrase.
   - `evidence`: a short verbatim fragment of the text (at most 15 words) supporting the relation.
   - Do NOT invent relations the text does not support. Few or no relations is a correct answer. Do NOT add a relation for every co-occurring pair.
2. `newRelationTypes`: [{ "name", "definition" }] — one entry with a one-line definition for EVERY type you wrote yourself (fit "new").

### FINAL OUTPUT FORMAT ###
First think through the report in free form (who did what to whom, with which tools). Keep this BRIEF and do NOT use curly braces { } anywhere in it. Then output a single raw JSON object: { "relations": [...], "newRelationTypes": [...] }. No markdown code fences, no commentary after the JSON. If nothing is found: { "relations": [], "newRelationTypes": [] }.

Apply these instructions to the report in the user's next message.

Загальна інформація

Урядовою командою реагування на комп'ютерні надзвичайні події України CERT-UA зафіксовано факт масового розповсюдження електронних листів з темою "Об'єднаний офіційний звіт про гуманітарну ситуацію. Україна" та вкладенням у вигляді XLS-документу "Гуманітарна катастрофа України з 24 лютого 2022 року.xls". При цьому електронні листи розсилаються зі скомпрометованих електронних адрес державних органів України.

Згаданий документ містить макрос, активація якого призведе до запуску файлу "baseupd.exe", виконання якого призведе до ураження комп'ютера шкідливою програмою Cobalt Strike Beacon.

CERT-UA вживаються заходи зі встановлення обставин компрометації облікових записів електронної пошти, а також блокування серверу управління шкідливою програмою.

Виходячи з використаних тактик, активність асоційовано з діяльністю групи UAC-0056.

Наполегливо рекомендуємо запровадити використання багатофакторної автентифікації для електронної пошти.
